## Design

### 2026-10-19 – Started buiding the schematics for my project, then realised in the middle that my resistors for 5.1k wont work because my resistors that i plan to buy with starbie don't contain 5.1k's so im parallel

**1.22h**

Started buiding the schematics for my project, then realised in the middle that my resistors for 5.1k wont work because my resistors that i plan to buy with starbie don't contain 5.1k's so im paralleling 2 10ks. I also made an analog multiplexer to change the sounds of the notes, as well as make a coordinate based key system.

### 2026-10-19 – finished the schematic, which needed an extra dac output thingy. i also assigned the footprints, which took a bit but weren't too annoying. finally, i also arranged most of the pcb, putting the diodes

**1.48h**

finished the schematic, which needed an extra dac output thingy. i also assigned the footprints, which took a bit but weren't too annoying. finally, i also arranged most of the pcb, putting the diodes under the keys, with a key arrangement that is expecting a CAD modelled piano keys. Also arranged most of the components but haven't wired yet, which may need to undergo revision.

### 2026-10-20 – wired a lot of the pcb today, discovered the trhough hole tool (V) which proved to be extremely useful but it is still like trying to solve that pipes game. anyhow, i wired all the diodes to the butto

**1.97h**

wired a lot of the pcb today, discovered the trhough hole tool (V) which proved to be extremely useful but it is still like trying to solve that pipes game. anyhow, i wired all the diodes to the buttons, and also wired some of the pots to the PICO, as well as wiring the resistors and the cable plug.
